about: sha256 of every contract WASM built by scripts/build-contracts-docker.sh (Docker rust:1.97.0, linux/amd64, path remapping). CI (reproducible-contracts) rebuilds them and fails on any difference. macOS aarch64 builds hash differently; use the Docker build or the CI artifact. After an intended contract change run `npm run contracts:docker -- --write` (or copy the hashes from the CI job summary).

testnetDeploymentsNotFromThisBuild.about: Testnet records whose deployed WASM was built before reproducible builds (or from older source) and so cannot match today's build. Each entry pins the exact recorded hash: a new deployment record must either match the reproducible build or be added here on purpose. Mainnet deploys must never appear here.
